newsitem.title: USA: CBOT July soybeans surge on private stock forecast.
newsitem.headline: CBOT July soybeans surge on private stock forecast.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures surged higher early Tuesday, rallying on a private forecast indicating tight old crop ending stocks, traders said.
"Everybody is focusing on the Sparks numbers," a floor trader said.

Consulting firm Sparks Cos. of Memphis, Tenn. was said to forecast 1996/97 (Sept/Aug) soybean ending stocks at 115 million bushels, trade sources said. Sparks was also said to put new crop ending stocks at 123 million bushels. Sparks officials were unavailable for comment on the numbers.
Nearly ideal crop weather in the U.S. Midwest was limiting gains in new crop November, traders said.
In early trade, ING, Prudential Securities and ADM each bought 500,000 bushels July. ABN-Amro Chicago Corp spread one million July/November and Refco sold one million July, pit traders said.
